verdict.rationale: Data region and residency selection is a fair question for a cloud SaaS workspace like Notion, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents choosing a storage region or residency. The community note that Notion is tied to its own cloud says nothing about region choice, so it neither supports nor contradicts this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
